Measured 2026-11-18 against the real library: 38,397 Supreme Court judgments and 3,830 statute sections (16 Acts).
Rebuild the set: node --import tsx scripts/build-gold.ts   Re-measure: node --import tsx scripts/eval-library.ts

Where the statutes come from (scripts/statutes/assemble.py; priority top to bottom, lower sources fill gaps only):
  1. India Code, indiacode.gov.in JSON API (fetch_india_code.py): BNS, BNSS, BSA, CPC, SC/ST Act, NIA, ICA, NDPS, PMLA, ITA, POCSO, PCA
  2. Official PDFs (extract_pdf_acts.py): CrPC 1973 (WIPO Lex copy of the India Code PDF, last modified 2011, so later
     amendments may be missing), Constitution (Legislative Department, English-Kannada edition as on 11 Nov 2025),
     IPC 1860 and Indian Evidence Act 1872 (WIPO Lex copies; the Evidence Act is amended to Act 34 of 2019)
  3. Open India Law (CC BY 4.0), only for sections nothing else had: 20 IPC, 2 IEA, 2 ICA, 6 PCA sections
Section titles agree between India Code and Open India Law for the great majority of overlapping sections; where they differ
the older dataset usually holds footnote text as the title.

Known limits:
- 96 INSC numbers are carried by more than one record (216 records, 0.56%); they come back "partial / ambiguous", never verified.
- SCC, AIR, SCC OnLine, SCALE and High Court neutral citations are "not covered": the source holds INSC and SCR only.
- CPC Orders and Rules (First Schedule) are not loaded: "Order XXXIX Rule 1 CPC" reads "not covered".
- Section numbers with no record: Constitution 238 and 389 (omitted articles); IPC 13, 15, 17, 56, 58, 59, 61, 62, 162-165, 226,
  480, 490, 492 (all but 17 are omitted or repealed sections, 17 is a real gap); IEA 145 and 161 (145 is a real gap).
- Sub-clauses ("Section 103(1)(a)") are looked up as the section; the sub-clause itself is not checked.
- The hand-typed seed rows (legal_provisions) no longer back "verified"; they still feed search.
- The Constitution text comes from a two-language edition: titles are clean, article text is English-only with some leftover
  footnote markers.
